title: ProgressionGuild
description: Full-featured guild system for Paper RPG servers — create guilds, manage members and ranks, share a guild bank, and level your guild together.
body:
# ⚔ ProgressionGuild

ProgressionGuild adds a complete guild framework to your RPG server. Players create guilds, invite friends, build internal hierarchies, pool resources in a shared bank, and level their guild over time. It's the social glue that turns a group of players into a real faction — and keeps them coming back.

## Features

- **Guild creation & management** — create, rename, disband, transfer ownership
- **Invite system** — invite, accept, deny with persistent requests
- **Rank system** — promote, demote, kick members with configurable permission tiers
- **Guild bank** — shared economy storage accessible by rank
- **Guild house** — set a guild anchor/warp location
- **Guild XP & leveling** — guilds grow through member activity
- **Admin tools** — force-transfer, disband, set XP, set level from the console

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/guild create <name>` | Create a new guild |
| `/guild invite <player>` | Invite a player to your guild |
| `/guild bank` | Open the shared guild bank |
| `/guild info` | Show guild stats and members |
| `/guild admin` | Admin management subcommands |

## Dependencies

Requires **ProgressionAPI**. Integrates optionally with **ProgressionEconomy** (guild bank) and **ProgressionParty** (shared party/guild events).

---
Part of the **Rosewood Progression** ecosystem — built for RPG and MMO-style Paper servers.
